raw_snippet: The Baldwin Group to Go Private Through Majority Investment by Sequence Holdings and Dell Family Office
value_text: acquired The Baldwin Group (insurance broker, USA)
note: Take-private with co-investor DFO Management (Dell Family Office); majority interest via an entity formed by Sequence and DFO. Signed, not closed: expected Q1 2027. Price is enterprise value. Date: Definitive agreement announced; closing expected Q1 2027. Stated price about $7.70bn.
